description: Shop-level job defaults for the generate pipeline (companion to tools.json). Values here supply the top-most (job/plate) layer of the cascade: labels may still override them per label or per text line. plate_width/plate_height are the default plate size (plate layer + unbounded auto-allocation); left_clearance/top_clearance are the default plate edge clearances. Fields configured nowhere (missing here AND missing from the job spec) are required: max_h_compress, hole_margin, min_hole_margin, hole_text_collision_distance, plate_width, plate_height. Maintain one file per engraver/toolset and select it with 'plt-optimizer generate --job-config <path>'.
